cache:
  enabled: true
  dir: /data/cache
  port: 8088
  proxy_port: 8089
container:
  docker_host: "-"
  workdir_parent: shared/workdir
host:
  workdir_parent: /data/act
kubernetes:
  namespace: forgejo
  poll_timeout: 10m
log:
  level: info
plugins:
  k8s:
    address: "unix:///plugin/forgejo-runner-k8s.sock"
    options:
      namespace: forgejo
      poll_timeout: 10m
      labels: "app.kubernetes.io/name=forgejo-runner-instance,egress.home.arpa/custom-egress=true"
      resources: |
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 256Mi
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
runner:
  capacity: 3
  labels:
    - ubuntu-latest:k8s:///config/podspec-default.yaml
    - default:k8s:///config/podspec-default.yaml
    - docker:k8s:///config/podspec-dind.yaml
    - multiarch:k8s:///config/podspec-dind.yaml  # you need binfmt-misc extension for multiarch
  timeout: 3h
  shutdown_timeout: 3m

containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS
        value: "4"
      - name: MAKEFLAGS
        value: "-j4"
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:8b7a25c7b3235c27e97df1cbb8411c1d12d2676e739265b5fbb66bb55f72dbf6
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 1
        memory: 2Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 6
        memory: 20Gi
# runner-k8s-plugin defaults the shared workdir emptyDir to 10Gi,
# too small for CEF builds; kubelet evicts the pod on emptydirfs.limit.
volumes:
  - name: shared
    emptyDir:
      sizeLimit: 50Gi
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
              operator: In
              values:
                - kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    args:
      - --ipv6
      - --fixed-cidr-v6=fd00:d1d::/64
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 250m
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 4
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
      - name: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS
        value: "4"
      - name: MAKEFLAGS
        value: "-j4"
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:8b7a25c7b3235c27e97df1cbb8411c1d12d2676e739265b5fbb66bb55f72dbf6
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 1
        memory: 2Gi
      limits:
        cpu: 6
        memory: 20Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: shared
    emptyDir:
      sizeLimit: 50Gi
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
              operator: In
              values:
                - kharkiv
restartPolicy: Never

# Guard against the export race seen after the 2026-09-03 paris reboot:
# if this pod starts before Talos has mounted the e-media volume at
# /var/mnt/media, nfsd caches its fsid=0 pseudo-root against the empty
# mountpoint. Every client mount then fails immediately with
# "NFS4: Couldn't follow remote path" while the pod still looks healthy,
# and only a pod restart clears it (exportfs -ra does not).
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if [ -d /mnt/media/backups ] && [ -d /mnt/media/kopiur ]; then
    echo "media volume is mounted, proceeding"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "waiting for /var/mnt/media to be mounted ($i/60)"
  sleep 2
done
echo "media volume still not mounted after 120s; refusing to export" >&2
exit 1

set -euo pipefail
# Hourly dump into a temp file, checked before it replaces anything, so a failed or
# truncated dump can never overwrite a good one. One file per weekday keeps seven
# days of history; postgres17-cluster.dump.gz stays the latest (restore.yaml uses it).
out="/backup/postgres17-cluster-$(date +%a).dump.gz"
pg_dumpall -U "$PGUSER" | gzip > "$out.tmp"
gzip -t "$out.tmp"
mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
cp "$out" /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz.tmp
mv /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz.tmp /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz
